steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each revision is placed by its effective date against its approval date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 revision takes effect before it is approved

findings.title: Effective date before the approval date
findings.fix: Correct the date or re-approve the change

findings.title: Changed part with no stock plan
findings.fix: Write the stock plan for the old and new part

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] bom-rev-09.md:12  Effective date before the approval date.
       Fix: Correct the date or re-approve the change.
[medium] bom-rev-11.md:19  Changed part with no stock plan.
       Fix: Write the stock plan for the old and new part.
[low] bom-rev-07.md:26  Revision with no effective date.
       Fix: Set the effective date.
Not checked: Engineering correctness of the change.
pros: Checks a revision with no effective date, a changed part with no stock plan, and an effective date before the approval date.
cons: Not checked: Engineering correctness of the change.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-bom-change-review skill on the records for this review.
